name: St Winifred, St Mary and St Bernard
shortName: St Winifred, St Mary and St Bernard

boundary.description: From the junction of Egerton Road and Royle Street, E along Royle Street, Kingswood Road, Kingsway, Grangethorpe Road, Crossley Road, Stockport Road, Norfolk Avenue. Then by a beeline to and along Carnforth Road, Nelstrop Road, Broadstone Road, Manchester Road, Whitehill Street West, Greg Street, Birkdale Road, Sandy Lane, Willow Avenue and by a beeline to River Tame ( all Woodhall Crescent estate in St Mary’s parish). S by River Tame and River Mersey. Then N along Manchester Stockport District boundary to Barcicroft Road, Westcroft Road, Parrs Wood Road and Egerton Road to its junction with Royle Street.

internalBoundaries.description: From the point where the railway crosses Crossley Road, S along the railway to and W along Heaton Road, Alexandra Road, Green Lane, by a footpath across Bowerfold Open Space to Green Lane , through M60 junction 1 to River Mersey.
